description: Survival-legal Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2: material calculators, mining planners, and a fishing bobber bite glow — plans and highlights, never automates or reveals hidden info.

mods.name: Foreman
mods.description: Survival-legal planning and instrumentation tools: exact material lists for terraforming, and a bite indicator that finally makes the fishing bobber visible in the dark. Foreman never places, breaks, mines, or reveals anything you couldn't already see yourself — it just computes and shows.
